articles.title_en: Mediazona names 26 more troops killed in March’s crash of an An-26 military transport plane in Crimea
articles.lead_en: Journalists at the independent Russian outlet Mediazona identified 27 military personnel believed to have died when an An-26 aircraft crashed in annexed Crimea in March.

articles.title_en: Fire at Russia’s Amur Gas Chemical Complex — one of the world’s largest chemical plants — kills 15
articles.lead_en: A large-scale fire at the construction site of the Amur Gas Chemical Complex (AGCC), which is being readied for launch, has killed 15 people, and search-and-rescue operations have now ended, the company’s press service said.
